Episode 128: Zephyrin (5)
The void space opened by Bradamante's strike was like a broken dam.
Although Zephyrin tried to return it to its original state according to her will, the blue flame stuck to the torn part of the void space wouldn't allow it.
The cracks were closing, tearing open again, and burning.
The void space was reacting to the blue flames spread by Jin as if it were a living organism. It screamed with a sharp cry every time space was torn, spewing purple magic like blood.
Zephyrin's appearance was constantly changing as the void space writhed.
Her body was shrinking and becoming distorted, taking on a grotesque shape.
It was clear evidence that her transformation was only effective within a 'normal state of void space.'
[Kekekekek, Kheheheheh!]
Murakan burst into laughter at the sight, looking extremely delighted. Even while catching his breath, it seemed difficult to contain his overwhelming joy.
[Ah, you little one. You were nothing once you left your territory! No wonder you were too powerful. I've never seen or heard of anyone like you before.]
Zephyrin let out a short moan. It seemed she was exerting a lot of effort to maintain her body as normal as possible while it kept twisting.
'Damn it! I knew I didn't have a good feeling about it when I saw that cursed power of the blue flame!'
As the contractor of Solderet, Zephyrin naturally expected Jin to be able to cut her void space.

However, she hadn't thought it would have such a significant impact on her transformation and manipulation of the divine power. That's because her magic far surpassed the energy possessed by Jin and Murakan.
Not including the power of the blue flame in her calculations was the problem.
The first time the void space was torn was due to the energy, but the one suppressing the cracks from healing was the blue flame.
To be precise, she was aware of the fact that Jin was Tess's contractor.
She was just convinced that the power of the blue flame Jin could wield was extremely limited.
'Come to think of it, Jin Runcandel. How are you using such a dense blue flame without even summoning Lord Tess...?'
She didn't think of that when Jin first brought out the blue flame. It was just instinctive fear and revulsion that overwhelmed her.

But now, the blue flames tearing and burning the void space contained a much deeper and more intense energy than what Zephyrin had experienced a few times in the past from other 'human contractors of Tess.'
It was as if the owner of the flame realm had not 'lent' a tiny bit of power, but 'handed over' a part of themselves entirely...
'No way...!'
As her thoughts reached that point, Zephyrin's eyes widened.
-[I couldn't make the attack side better, but thanks to Tess's flames, a new power has settled within me without me knowing. They call it pressure, I guess?]
It was what Picon Minche, who had incarnated through an empty branch during Bradamante's enhancement, had said.
That day, Tess permanently imbued part of her power in the flame realm into the contractor's sword.

In any situation, that is to say, even when facing such a formidable opponent, the desired result was to use the tremendous power of the pressure regardless of the presence or absence of magical power.
Moreover, in case Jin encountered a powerful enemy who had 'met' Tess in person, it was also intended to serve as a warning.
Anyone who harms this child
Will become my enemy
The azure flame embedded in Bradamante was the emblem and proof of the owner of the Flame World.
Only those who had directly met Tess could recognize it.
For Zephyrin, the fact that the ruthless owner of the Flame World would bestow part of his power upon a mere human contractor was something unimaginable.
To Tess, human contractors were merely tools for amusement and vigilance. At least, that's what Zephyrin knew.
There were times when a contractor had pleased Tess's heart, but this was the first time Tess had provided his own power to a contractor.
What could possibly be lacking for an absolute being who could wipe out a middle-ranked god in a single breath...?
Zephyrin clenched her teeth.
'It's unfair. Giving that power, which you said you couldn't even give to my master, to such a mere human!'
An intense surge of anger rose within her, making her want to tear everything in sight to shreds right away.
If the space wasn't crumbling, it would have been entirely possible. However, the true flame of Tess showed no signs of going out.
Gasping, wheezing, and cackling...!
Her twisted body made it impossible for her to even control her breath.
Adding insult to injury, Murakan (still laughing) shouted like this.
"Hahaha! Hey, what are you doing! Let's have fun and beat that thing up!"
Murakan spewed out a black breath, and Valkas and Shakhudo leaped in and launched a thunderous attack. Jin protected the Black Knight in Valkas' stead.
To be honest, everyone had felt a sense of despair when Zephyrin showed her complete recovery with her incredible regenerative power.
However, if Zephyrin remained in this unstable state, it was worth a try. They may not be able to win a life-or-death battle, but it seemed feasible to achieve their goal of escape.
"Kaaak!"
As the party's attack began, Zephyrin screamed in pain. Clearly, their attacks were now effectively connecting with her.
Yet, she had not completely lost her combat ability.
Zephyrin's writhing movements alone still posed a threatening attack to the approaching party members.
The magical power pouring out of Zephyrin's body like an avalanche was also dangerous. The fight was possible only because the party members originally had outstanding combat abilities.
Murakan's newfound favorite word, "beating," became more and more persistent as time went on. Just looking at the scene, it was hard to tell which side was the villain.
"Die!"
"Haaaa!"
"For the Jin brothers!"
However, the lively and rhythmic beating, like well-ripened sesame seeds falling off, could also be seen as evidence of the anxiety the party members were harboring.
Although they couldn't do anything at the moment due to the continuously burning space, there was a lingering ominous feeling that Zephyrin would eventually recover her strength and find a way.
Too many cracks had formed.

The space could no longer maintain a complete and independent structure. The scenery of the reception room was visible through the gaps, and so were the faces of the Black King's Order members standing with stern expressions.
Until Jin cut through the space, the members had no idea what was happening inside the reception room engulfed by magic.
When some members, sensing the commotion, opened the reception room, all they saw was a purple darkness, and the rest of the captains immediately declared a state of emergency.
"It's the captain! The captain is in battle!"
"We've confirmed the life and death of the captain and the guests!"
The desperate voices of the members could be heard.
Almost everyone in the Black King's Order seemed to be waiting around the reception room and nearby.
They seemed to want to enter the space and join the fight, and they seemed shocked to see their captain fighting so desperately.
If the Black King's Order's First Army were to join the battle, the odds could tilt in favor of the party once more.
However, Jin was still convinced that the objective of the battle should be focused on escape, not victory. No matter what might happen, and even though they were now engulfed by the azure flame.
The space was clearly the most advantageous territory for the enemy.
"Don't come in, stay back!"
"What do you mean?"
The members had no intention of listening to Jin's words.
But when Valkas, who belatedly saw his subordinates, shouted the same thing as Jin, the Black King's Order immediately halted their entry.
"Black King's Order! From this moment on, follow the guidance of the 12th generation until further orders are given!"
Before cutting through the space, Murakan had told Valkas to escape with Jin and his subordinates while he would handle Zephyrin.
Although the opportunity had come, Valkas decided not to leave Murakan behind. As the leader, it was unthinkable to rely solely on others to protect his subordinates.
"Understood!"
"Roger that!"
The members did not question Valkas's command. It was a testament to how much trust they had in their captain.
[You, where...!]
Kiaaak!
With a deafening roar, Zephyrin suddenly released an explosive surge of magical power.

She then transformed back into a human form, giving up on maintaining her original appearance. In the unstable state of the space, she decided it was more efficient to maintain her human form and fight.
Now, Zephyrin was also desperate. Sharp magical energy poured from her nails as she began to rampage again.
Moreover, that wasn't all.
'The azure flame is gradually diminishing...!'
Even if it were to go out completely, it wouldn't be the same as before since they had already suffered so much damage.
At that time, the party members were exhausted, so the battle would likely be more dangerous than before.
Therefore, they had to evacuate the Black King's Order members as quickly as possible.
[Tear them all apart... I'll kill them all, these insect-like creatures!]
If only their master had been in good shape, this absurd situation would not have occurred.
Zephyrin felt a heavy weight in her chest at that thought.
Although not as much as Murakan, Zephyrin was also in a weakened state due to her master's poor condition.
'Of all things, the recent deterioration of my master's condition is largely due to these creatures.'
Oof!
As Zephyrin let out a groan instead of the polite language she had been using consistently, Murakan burst into laughter once again.
[Heh, it's always when you guys are cornered that your true colors show. Hey, kid! Don't worry and get out of here with the others.]
"12th generation, please take care of my subordinates!"
"Go ahead, brother!"
Jin nodded and replied as such.
"I'll evacuate the members and rejoin you!"
[Nah, no need for that, see you at home.]
Hwaaak!
[Mya!]
Shuri was summoned with a radiant crimson glow.
Without Jin even saying anything, Shuri seemed to understand the situation, immediately grabbing the fallen Black Knight in her mouth.
[Mya-mya.]
Shuri, carrying Jin, dashed across the gap in the space like an arrow. A light breeze tickled their noses.
The Black King's Order members in front of the space were waiting for Jin to come out.
"Give the order, 12th generation!"

"All members will evacuate. The 3rd Army will prioritize securing supplies, the 2nd Army will help evacuate the wounded and non-combatants. The 1st Army will oversee the entire evacuation, and detailed orders will be organized by each captain and their subordinates."
"Understood!"
As Jin gave the order, the members quickly dispersed, and the gap and flames in the space behind them noticeably shrank.
